name: @insolvia/admin
//: OUTSIDE the npm workspace, like apps/insolvia_marketing and for the same
reason: its own lockfile is what proves a clean registry install of the
published @insolvia-ai/design-system works, and keeps a second React tree
off the root lockfile. Never add it to the root `workspaces` list.
@insolvia-ai/design-system is a devDependency because everything is
bundled at build time (this is a static SPA — nothing installs at
runtime); installing it needs GitHub Packages auth (see .npmrc).
Never point it at a local checkout — published versions only (ADR 0010).
The dev server is PINNED to port 3100 (strictPort in vite.config.ts):
Google's OAuth redirect URIs are exact-match, the dev client registers
http://localhost:3100/auth/callback, and the tenant app owns :3000.
